# Webs with a recent giving

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`webs-with-a-recent-giving` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](webs-with-a-recent-giving.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A web whose giving reads what each condition gave last keeps the order of states under mutual support, so its bounded runs have ending decided and each threshold exact and at most what it was as any level or recent giving rises; what was given can lower a threshold.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A law of states reads them condition by condition where states alike at every condition go to states alike; runs of such a law stay alike, and the web's step is one; the web's run_alike is now this law's case. (`Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.ReadsPointwise`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.run_alike_of`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.pointwise_step`)
2. Ending under a law; a law keeping the order of states reads them condition by condition, by antisymmetry; the web's step keeps it under mutual support; runs keep the order, ending is down-closed, and a run reaching a state its law leaves as it is stays there. (`Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.EndsUnder`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.KeepsBelow`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.step_keepsBelow`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.reads_of_keepsBelow`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.run_below_of`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.endsUnder_of_below`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.stays_at`)
3. A web with a recent giving holds each condition's level and what it gave last, its giving a law of what is left of all and what each gave; under mutual support it keeps the order of states, so RM9's bounded laws hold of it. (`Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.step`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Rises`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.keepsBelow`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.both`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.mem_both`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.covers_both`)
4. Where giving reads nothing of what was given, its levels run as the plain web's; one condition is the adjusted regime, level and recent giving at every step. (`Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.plain`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.ofAdjusted`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.adjusted`)
5. Witness: one condition under a draw of two gives one where something is left and nothing was given last, two where something was; its threshold, levels up to four, is four having given nothing and three having given one. (`Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.gives`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.giving`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.gives_rises`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.rises`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.at_`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.ramp`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.set_at`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.ends_from`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.holds_from`, `Becoming.RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Recent.Momentum.threshold_falls_with_recent`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Whole numbers; finitely many conditions listed by a list covering them; draws taken first, as much as there is; each giving a law of what is left of all and what each gave last, read condition by condition (for the decision) and rising with each (mutual support, for the threshold); the run from the top level considered within a bound B; discrete steps.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Rest within a band for webs with a recent giving: RM3's measure for one condition is not lifted to webs.
- Giving reading more than the last step; runs without bound; amounts beyond whole numbers.
- That measured conditions give by what they gave last, or by how much.

### Correspondence
